mobbin:40bd9265-6569-49af-a402-77cd8de34.summary: From Teams, admin adds a team event type, chooses Collective/Round Robin/Managed assignment, configures maximize-availability vs load-balancing hosts, and sees the Collective event on the Event Types list.
steps: Teams hub — Collective or round-robin recommended step
Add team event modal — Collective / Round Robin / Managed
Title + URL slug for Team Quick Chat
Assignment: Collective; Maximize availability vs Load balancing; Fixed hosts
Assignment saved toast; Add all team members toggle off
Event Types list — Team Quick Chat with Collective badge
steal: Assignment choice at create: Collective (all available) vs Round Robin (cycle) vs Managed (bulk distribute) — steps 1–3
Distribution: Maximize availability vs Load balancing with plain-language copy — steps 4–5
Fixed hosts + "Add all team members, including future members" toggle — step 5
List badge shows scheduling type (Collective) beside duration — step 6
avoid: Deep event settings sidebar (Setup/Availability/Limits/Advanced/…) — heavy for a simple session type
mobbin:40bd9265-6569-49af-a402-77cd8de34.fit: Matches baseline faculty rotation (collective panel vs round-robin pool); use for multi-faculty scenario runs without rebuilding OSCE complexity.

mobbin:23bf0af9-943c-4ed2-ad8f-6203131d5.summary: Invitee picks duration and date/time on the public booking page, fills name/email/location/custom fields, confirms, and lands on a recurring-booking success page with calendar add options.
steps: Booking page: event meta, duration pills, calendar, time slots
Pick another date; new slot list
Confirm form: name, email, location radios, notes, guests, custom Q
Success: recurring scheduled; Host badge; Cancel link
Add to calendar providers + Google spam policy warning
steal: Self-sign-up three-pane: details → month → slot list with green available dots — steps 0–4
Inline duration chips change offered slots before confirm — steps 0–1
Occurrence validation with clear range error — step 2
Success: Host badge, intake answers echoed, Add to calendar (Google/Outlook/Office/ICS) — steps 7–8
avoid: Booker-controlled "Every week for N occurrences" on an onboarding-style event — easy to mis-set vs coordinator-owned series
mobbin:23bf0af9-943c-4ed2-ad8f-6203131d5.fit: Learner-side self-sign-up into a capacity/slot model; extend for sim session booking + Outlook write-back; not Excel bulk create.
